## AI Quiz Generator
Paste lesson notes, get a ready-to-use quiz with answers, distractors and a printable answer key.

POST `{notes, count}` (lesson notes as text). Definition sentences become multiple-choice and fill-in-the-blank questions with on-topic distractors. Returns the quiz and answer key; connect a Google Forms or Docs node to publish it.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/ai-quiz-generator
